pr_title: refactor(core): Simplify mermaid.ink API URL construction
top_warning_text: This PR removes the URL encoding of background_color that was added to fix HTTP 400 errors when using named colors like 'white' with the mermaid.ink API (issue #34444).

pr_title: refactor(langchain): simplify summarization middleware message slicing logic
top_warning_text: This PR removes the backward search logic that preserves AIMessage/ToolMessage pairs together, reverting to the simple forward-advance approach that was fixed in commit 2b6911d because it caused "No tool call found for function call output" errors when tool responses were orphaned from their AIMessage requests.

This PR removes the empty load response handling logic added in d40fd5a that prevents agents from terminating prematurely when Ollama returns done_reason='load' with no content, and also deletes core methods like _generate, _stream, _agenerate, _astream, and with_structured_output.

pr_title: refactor(openai): Simplify embeddings batching logic for better performance
top_warning_text: This PR removes the dynamic batching logic that respects MAX_TOKENS_PER_REQUEST (300k), reverting to fixed-size batching that caused BadRequest errors when batches exceeded OpenAI's token limit.
